title: G2U Signed Envelope v1
description: Wraps any G2U event with an Ed25519 signature.

key_id.description: Identifier for the public key that should verify this signature.

payload.description: One of g2u.track.v1 / g2u.cue.v1 / g2u.negative.v1 / g2u.coverage.v1 / g2u.health.v1

signature.description: Base64-urlsafe Ed25519 signature over canonical JSON of payload.
